Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 10  
Reason for Mistake: In Step 10, the Planner incorrectly identified the meeting point of the Mississippi River and the Ohio River as "Cairo, Illinois," but later conflicting coordinates (~38.866 N, -90.118 W near St. Louis, Missouri) were introduced and dismissed without adequate verification. The Planner should have cross-checked the coordinates thoroughly to determine the correct confluence location. This oversight led to an ambiguous and potentially incorrect solution to the real-world problem.
